# AL1311: Unnecessary LINQ materialization

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Info |
| Category | `Usage` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Al1311UnnecessaryLinqMaterializationAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

Calling ToList() or ToArray() immediately after Where(), Select(), or other LINQ operators forces eager evaluation. If the result is only enumerated once, deferred execution avoids allocating an intermediate collection.
